Glassnode: Bitcoin Hashrate Falls 8% YoY, First Annual Decline Since China's 2021 Mining Ban

Glassnode said Bitcoin’s hashrate has declined approximately 8% year-over-year, marking its first annual contraction since China’s 2021 Bitcoin mining ban. Unlike the policy-driven decline in 2021, the current contraction is driven by falling BTC prices and deteriorating mining profitability, prompting some miners to shut down their machines. Bitcoin’s hashprice has reached an all-time low, further increasing financial pressure on miners. — link

The proceeds were used to repay Aave loans, reducing its outstanding debt by 81% to $10.5 million and lowering its loan-to-value ratio to 32%.
